text:
Jamal (oncall): Heads-up — I'm opening a small rollback PR for kv-proxy after a p99 jump in prod-ap-northeast. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8721 Can someone take a quick look? Need a merge + canary tonight.
Sasha: On it. Can you share perf numbers and who's the owner of the change?
Jamal (oncall): Owner is @Alex. Observed p99 from ~120ms -> ~450ms for ~15m, traces point at conn-pool backoff increase. Revert is basically one line in the proxy config:
```diff
- conn_pool.backoff = 150ms
+ conn_pool.backoff = 50ms
```
ci-bot: CI build #8742 — unit + integration tests passed. :white_check_mark:
Priya: tagging @SRE-rotation for awareness. Priya: please watch the canary after merge.
Priya: @Jamal (oncall) what's the preferred merge window? we have a maintenance window at 02:00 UTC, otherwise prefer immediate if impact persists.
Jamal (oncall): leaning immediate since impact ongoing; will do a 10% canary for 15m post-merge. If that's a problem we can wait until 02:00 UTC.
Alex: I'll do a quick review now. scanning...
Sasha: quick thought — can we add a tiny replay test hitting the backoff path? even a simple harness would be helpful.
Alex: left a 1-line comment on the PR about the log level; otherwise lgtm. :thumbsup:
Jamal (oncall): thanks @Alex — pushing the log fix now.
Alex: merged and started canary. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: infra/pr/8721 -> canary (10% traffic). Estimated convergence ~15m.
Priya: watching traces/dashboards now.
Jamal (oncall): canary at 10m looks good — p99 back to ~130ms. No errors in traces. Ready to ramp if no regressions.
Sasha: ack — I'll keep an eye on dashboards for 30m.
Priya: if stable at 30m, please proceed to 100% and log the incident note. :memo:
Jamal (oncall): will do. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
